question: Who was the First Indian actress to win an international award at the 1963 Moscow International Film Festival?
solution: The correct answer is __**Suchitra Sen**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Suchitra Sen** was the first Indian actress to win an **international award** for her performance at the **1963 Moscow International Film Festival**. • She received this recognition for her role in the Bengali film **Saat Pake Bandha** (1963), which showcased her exceptional acting skills and made her internationally renowned. • Suchitra Sen was one of the most prominent actresses in Indian cinema, especially in the Bengali film industry, and is often regarded as a cultural icon. • The **Moscow International Film Festival** is one of the oldest and most prestigious film festivals in the world, and winning an award there was a significant achievement for Indian cinema. • This award marked a historic milestone for India, highlighting its talent and creativity on the global stage.
